An '''instance portal''' is sparkling field that marks the entrance to an [[instance]].

The color of the portal indicates the type of instance:
* <font color="blue">Blue</font> Instance Portal: [[Group]] (5 or less)
* <font color="green">Green</font> Instance Portal: [[Raid]] (10 or more)
* <font color="red">Red</font> Instance Portal: [[PvP]] Battlezone ([[battleground]])
